DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token. Never put it in TOML.

RELAY_FINGERPRINT.description: Relay TLS certificate SHA-256. Use the same suffix as its URL.

RELAY_KEY.description: Relay API key. Use the same suffix as its URL.

RELAY_URL.description: Relay HTTPS URL. Add _2, _3 and so on for more relays.

audit_channel_id.description: Audit channel id. Zero disables the channel.

blowup_user_id.description: User to ping with /blowup. Zero disables it.

commands_channel_id.description: Extra slash-command channel id. Zero disables it.

debug_hours.description: Hours that debug logging stays on after a start, then info. Zero keeps it on.

edit_every.description: Default time between edits of a message without images.

green_ok.description: Use a green dot for healthy rows.

helper.description: Signed host-helper connection. The key goes in .env, under the name that key_env sets.

image_every.description: Default time between image uploads. A message with images changes only when they upload. The learned budget can delay uploads.

log_level.description: Log level. Changes need a restart.

node_updates.description: Trusted terminal commands printed by /update. The bot never runs them.

outputs.description: One block per output channel. Channel ids must be different.

perms.description: Command permissions. Unlisted users and roles have no tier.

preview.description: Authenticated config preview. Omit it to disable the page.

render.description: Render mode per section. Unset sections use image mode.

state_file.description: State file in the bot data volume.

tasks.description: Scheduled and running tasks. Running-task colors do not add alerts.

thresholds.description: Warning and critical levels. One number sets warning only.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for displayed times.

filter.description: Enabled activity kinds mapped to tracked repos to monitor.

latest.description: Maximum displayed items per activity list.

name.description: Display name. Do not include a private address.

pinned.description: Tracked repos shown first. They count toward latest.

show.description: Features to show. The default includes every feature the provider supports.

system_row.description: Add a short System row. At most one forge may enable it.

url.description: Forge API base URL. Forgejo needs its server URL without /api/v1.

socket.description: Unix socket path inside the bot container.

days.description: History retained in the data volume.

docker_proxy.description: Docker socket proxy URL. Omit it to disable Docker checks.

ignore.description: Netdata chart and alarm globs to hide.

url.description: Netdata base URL. Empty disables Netdata.

command.description: One trusted ASCII command line. The bot only prints it.

run_on.description: Host where the command is pasted. Omit to use hostname.

edit_every.description: Edit period. Omit to inherit the global value.

image_every.description: Image period. Omit to inherit the global value.

sections.description: Sections to show, in the top-level order. Omit to show all.

bind.description: Container listen IP. compose.yaml publishes no port; add one on a single host address.

password_hash.description: Password hash from python -m shazzzbot.preview hash.

user.description: Login name. Omit both credentials to generate a login.

allow.description: Container-name globs /docker restart may touch. Empty disables restarts.

groups.description: Group names mapped to container-name globs.

container.description: Docker container name. Omit it for an external check.

every.description: Check period. External checks need at least 60 seconds. Omit for the global cycle.

expect.description: Text that an HTTP response must contain.

public_tcp.description: Public TCP target, checked through a relay when configured.

public_url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL, checked through a relay when configured.

tcp.description: Local TCP target as host:port or [IPv6]:port.

url.description: Local HTTP or HTTPS probe URL.

vpn_url.description: VPN HTTP or HTTPS probe URL.

columns.description: Labels for Local, VPN and Public checks.

ignore.description: Service names or globs to skip entirely.

public_host.description: Public name or IP to probe through configured relays.

heavy_kinds.description: Task kinds to emphasize. An empty list disables this trigger.

ignore.description: Task names or globs to hide.

long_running_minutes.description: Emphasize long tasks. Zero or false disables the time trigger.

rename.description: Task names mapped to display names.

shown.description: Number of upcoming tasks to show.

disk_busy.description: Time a disk is busy. One number sets warning only.

iowait.description: CPU time waiting for disk I/O.

target.description: Read-only NUT target as name@host[:port]. The default port is 3493.
